preconditions.description: The number of categories N is between 1 and 10 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= W <= 10 for W in [int(line.split()[1]) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:N+1]])
preconditions.description: Each category has between 1 and 10 associated words inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(len(word) <= 30 for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:N+1] for word in line.split()[2:])
preconditions.description: Each word in the category descriptions is at most 30 lowercase letters long.

preconditions.expression: all(len(word) <= 30 for line in stdin.splitlines()[N+1:] for word in line.split())
preconditions.description: Each word in the problem statement is at most 30 lowercase letters long.
There are at least N + 2 lines in the input: N category descriptions and at least one statement line.

postconditions.expression: all(category in stdout.splitlines() for category in suggested_categories)
postconditions.description: All suggested categories are present in the output.

postconditions.expression: all(category in suggested_categories for category in stdout.splitlines())
postconditions.description: All categories in the output are suggested categories.
The output categories are in lexicographical order.

postconditions.expression: suggested_categories == [category for category, count in category_counts.items() if count == max(category_counts.values())]
postconditions.description: The suggested categories have the highest number of matches in the problem statement.
